ja: 劇中の数々の名シーンを拡張セットで再現！
ＭＧ ＲＸ-７８-２ガンダム Ｖｅｒ.３.０（別売・2013年8月店頭発売予定）を遊びつくす拡張セットが登場！
・ ガンダムの印象的な目を発光するイエローのＬＥＤユニット！
・ 様々なアクションポーズが楽しめる３種類のウエポン！
ハイパー・バズーカ ／ ビーム・ジャベリン ／ ガンダム・ハンマー
・ ３種類の「１／１ガンダム立像」をマーキングで再現できる水転写デカール！
当商品は、２０１３年８月店頭発売予定 「ＭＧ 1/100 ＲＸ-７８-２ガンダム Ｖｅｒ.３.０」（別売）に
装着して、いろいろなシ－ン再現をして楽しむための拡張セットです。
〈セット内容〉
● ガンプラＬＥＤユニット（イエロー） × １
● ハイパー・バズーカ × １
● ビーム・ジャベリン × １
● ガンダム・ハンマー × １
● 水転写デカール × １
※ 当商品に「ＭＧ 1/100 ＲＸ-７８-２ガンダム Ｖｅｒ.３.０」は含まれません。

en: Reproduce many famous scenes from the play with an expanded set!
Introducing an expansion set to play with MG RX-78-2 Gundam Ver. 3.0 (sold separately, 20138 in-store Release Scheduled)!
・Yellow LED unit that emits Gundam's impressive eyes!
・ 3 types of weapons that allow you to enjoy various action poses!
Hyper Bazooka / Beam Javelin / Gundam Hammer
- Water transfer decals that can reproduce three types of "1/1 Gundam statues" with markings!
This product will be released in 20138 in-store Release Scheduled "MG 1/100 RX-78-2 Gundam Ver.3.0" (sold separately)
An expansion set that you can enjoy by wearing it and recreating various scenes.
<Set contents>
● Gunpla LED unit (yellow) x 1
● Hyper Bazooka × 1
● Beam Javelin × 1
● Gundam Hammer × 1
● Water transfer decal × 1
*This product does not include "MG 1/100 RX-78-2 Gundam Ver.3.0".
* To reproduce the photos posted on this page, "MG 1/100 RX-78-2 Gundam Ver. 3.0" (sold separately) and this product are required.
Additionally, "MG 1/100 RX-78-2 Gundam Ver. 3.0" (sold separately) is not available for sale at Premium Bandai.
*If you would like to enjoy it as a ‘double bazooka’ equipment, one hyper bazooka can be attached to the main product (sold separately).
Included. In addition, the Hyper Bazooka that comes with the Ver. 3.0 main unit and the Hyper Bazooka (compatible with Ver. 3.0) in this product
(including the grip) are the same.
*Two batteries (LR41) are required for the Gunpla LED unit (yellow) to emit light. (sold separately)
Also, a Phillips screwdriver (sold separately) is required to secure the battery cover.
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Main product materials: PS/POM
・No adhesive is used for assembly
[This product does not include MG 1/100 RX-78-2 Gundam Ver.3.0]
*The kit in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
(remarks)
・This product is a limited edition item.
*We may sell items at events sponsored by our company or other projects.
*Cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
・ There is a limited number of this product available for sale at 'Premium Bandai'.
Please note that the item may be out of stock.
